## Description and Rationale

Independent solo developer from Türkiye, working
primarily in Python. My background is in building
reliable data and analysis tooling: static analysis
and AST parsing, graph data modeling, deterministic
CLI design, schema versioning, reproducible packaging
and CI pipelines.

I registered for this challenge because it combines
three things I care about: a well-defined prediction
problem on real operational data, a commitment to
open data, and a requirement to publish the full
solution as open source. Taxi-out time is a concrete,
measurable target, and the open-science framing means
the work stays useful after the competition ends.

My aim is a clean, fully reproducible pipeline
documented well enough that anyone can rerun it from
scratch.
